newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvia's Riga bourse plans April launch of index.
newsitem.headline: Latvia's Riga bourse plans April launch of index.

text.p: Latvia's Riga stock exchange said on Friday that the bourse planned a possible launch of an official bourse index in April.
"We are working on the stock exchange index which we most probabaly will launch in April," a bourse official told Reuters.
The index is planned to be a capitalisation-based index.
Two commercial banks already provide their own stock market indices, Rietumu Bank and Saules Bank, both started in January.
The stock exchange official said its index will track only a selection of the largest and most active stocks.
